controller.led_help: Sets the controller's lighting color based on the game's state.
controller.dead_zones_help: Apply configured dead zones to the sticks and analog triggers.
controller.emulate_triggers_help: Treat analog trigger movement as digital L and R button input.
controller.restore_defaults_help: Restores all binding configurations for the currently selected device to their defaults.
controller.use_device_haptics_help: Use native device haptics instead of controller rumble. Useful for devices with built-in gamepads.
controller.rumble_help: Configure your desired rumble intensities, then run a test to check how they feel.
controller.actions_keyboard_help: A key bound to any action here will REPLACE the default control for that action. Only bind buttons here that aren't used anywhere else.
controller.actions_help: A button bound to any action here will REPLACE the default control for that action. Only bind buttons here that aren't used anywhere else. The glyphs shown for in game actions will not change. This is not recommended for regular Gamecube controllers.
controller.press_key: Press a Key or Mouse Button...
controller.press_axis: Move Axis or press a Key or Button...

saves.export_failed_msg: The save file could not be exported.
saves.picker_failed: The save file picker could not be opened.
saves.import_toast_body: Reset to the main menu before importing saves.

saves.disc_mismatch: This save does not match the configured disc.

saves.import_body_multi: Choose the saves to import. Existing saves will be backed up first.
saves.import_version_note: This save is from a different region or platform than the configured disc and may not work correctly.
saves.import_backup_note: A backup will be made first.
saves.no_registered_mode: No registered game mode uses these saves.
saves.no_registered_mode_single: No registered game mode uses this save.

saves.restore_backup_body: Replace the current save and mod data with this backup?
saves.open_save_folder_failed: The save folder could not be opened in the file browser.
saves.delete_mod_data_body: Delete saved data for {id}? If a game save exists, a backup will be made first.
saves.save_detail_empty_mode: Import a save or start this mode to create one.
saves.save_detail_empty_unregistered: Restore a backup or import this save to use it again.
saves.transfer_help: Export a portable Dusklight archive with mod data, or a standard GCI for other tools.
saves.backup_retention: The {count} most recent backups are preserved.

touch_controls_editor.reset_body: Reset controls to their default layout. This will not be saved until you press Save.

achievements.desc_hero_of_twilight: Deliver the finishing blow to Ganondorf.
achievements.desc_three_heart_clear: Defeat Ganondorf with only 3 heart containers.
achievements.desc_completionist: Complete the game after collecting all equipment, heart containers, portals, bugs, poes, and hidden skills.
achievements.desc_princess_of_bugs: Deliver all 24 golden bugs to Agitha.
achievements.desc_hylian_loach: Obtain the Hylian Loach in your fishing journal.
achievements.desc_all_fish: Obtain all 6 species of fish in your fishing journal.
achievements.desc_a_big_heart: Reach maximum health with all 20 heart containers.
achievements.desc_cave_of_ordeals: Clear all 50 floors of the Cave of Ordeals.
achievements.desc_cave_of_ordeals_heartless: Clear all 50 floors of the Cave of Ordeals with only 3 heart containers.
achievements.desc_speedrun_12h: Defeat Ganondorf with a total save file play time under 12 hours.
achievements.desc_speedrun_8h: Defeat Ganondorf with a total save file play time under 6 hours.
achievements.desc_dark_hammer_one_hit: Defeat Darkhammer in a single hit.
achievements.desc_no_deaths_clear: Defeat Ganondorf with 0 deaths on your save file.
achievements.desc_untouchable: Kill 25 enemies in a row without taking damage.
achievements.desc_bow_100m_hit: Hit an enemy from over 100 meters away with the bow.
achievements.desc_rollstab_triple: Kill 3 enemies with a single rollstab.
achievements.desc_plumm_max: Score 61,454 points in the Plumm minigame.
achievements.desc_goat_30s: Herd all 20 goats into the pen in under 30 seconds.
achievements.desc_goat_20s: Herd all 20 goats into the pen in under 20 seconds.
achievements.desc_goat_18s: Herd all 20 goats into the pen in under 18 seconds.
achievements.desc_snowboard_70s: Finish the snowboarding minigame in under 70 seconds.
achievements.desc_canoe_perfect: Achieve a perfect score in the canoe minigame.
achievements.desc_star_2_under_40s: Complete the STAR Prize 2 minigame in under 40 seconds.
achievements.desc_star_2_under_30s: Complete the STAR Prize 2 minigame in under 30 seconds.
achievements.desc_friendly_fire: Get hit by your own cannonball.
achievements.desc_long_jump_attack: Travel more than 15 meters in a single jump attack before landing.
achievements.desc_email_me: Read a letter during the Dark Beast Ganon fight.
achievements.desc_heavy_hitter: Wear the Iron Boots during the end credits.
achievements.desc_fishing_rod_ganondorf: Confuse Ganondorf with the fishing rod.
achievements.desc_ganondorf_3hit: Finish off Ganondorf in the final duel after only 3 attacks.
achievements.desc_back_in_time: Perform the Back in Time glitch to play on the title screen.
achievements.desc_early_master_sword: Obtain the Master Sword before completing Midna's Desperate Hour.
achievements.desc_earliest_master_sword: Obtain the Master Sword before meeting Midna.
achievements.desc_speedrun_4h: Defeat Ganondorf with a total save file play time under 4 hours.
achievements.desc_no_fish_suit: Defeat Morpheel without equipping Zora Armor.
achievements.desc_null_item: Obtain the mysterious black rupee in the item wheel.
achievements.desc_stallord_skip: Leave Stallord's arena through the exit without defeating Stallord.
achievements.desc_lakebed_before_lanayru: Clear the Lakebed Temple before clearing Lanayru's Twilight.
achievements.desc_early_hidden_village: Rescue the Hidden Village before clearing Goron Mines.
achievements.desc_forest_temple_no_boomerang: Complete the Forest Temple without obtaining the Gale Boomerang.
achievements.desc_early_city: Obtain the Double Clawshots without obtaining the Dominion Rod.
achievements.desc_early_kakariko: Collect the Kakariko warp portal without warping the gorge bridge.

prelaunch.disc_image_help:
Set the disc image that Dusklight uses to launch the game.

Changes require a restart.
prelaunch.data_folder_help: The data folder is where Dusklight stores settings, saves, logs, texture replacements, and other app data.
prelaunch.data_migrated_note: Data will be migrated automatically on restart.

video.vsync_help: Synchronizes the frame rate to your monitor's refresh rate.
video.lock_aspect_ratio_help: Lock the game's aspect ratio to the original.
video.pause_on_focus_lost_help: Pause the game when window focus is lost.
video.fps_counter_help: Display the current framerate in a corner of the screen while playing.
video.remember_window_size_help: Save and restore the previous session's window size when opening Dusklight.
video.ui_scale_help: Scales the Dusklight interface relative to the display's DPI scale. Has no effect on the game's UI and HUD.
video.internal_resolution_help: Configure the resolution used for rendering the game. Higher values are more demanding on your graphics hardware.
video.shadow_resolution_help: Configure the shadow-map resolution. Higher values improve shadow quality but increase GPU and memory usage.
video.resampler_help: Configure the sampling method used when scaling the internal resolution for final presentation.
video.bloom_help: Configure the post-processing bloom effect. Classic uses the original bloom pass; Dusklight uses a higher-quality bloom pass.
video.bloom_brightness_help: Configure bloom intensity. Higher values make bright areas glow more strongly.
video.depth_of_field_help: Configure the post-processing depth-of-field effect. Classic uses the original depth-of-field pass; Dusklight uses a higher-quality depth-of-field pass.
video.unlock_framerate_help:
Uses inter-frame interpolation to enable higher frame rates.

May introduce minor visual artifacts or animation glitches.
video.framerate_cap_help: Limit the framerate to the specified value.
video.minimap_shadows_help: Render a thick shadow around the mini-map. May impact performance.
video.disable_pillarboxing_help: Disable black bars on the left and right sides of the screen during some cutscenes, particularly on ultra-wide displays. Visuals beyond the original intended framing may appear buggy.
video.disable_letterboxing_help: Disable the top and bottom black bars during L-targeting, aiming, cutscenes, dialogue, etc.

input.background_inputs_help: Allow inputs even when the game window is not focused.
input.touch_controls_help:
Enables controls overlay for touch screens.

Press and drag on the left side of the screen to move, and on the right side of the screen to control the camera.
input.customize_layout_help: Open the touch controls layout editor.
input.touch_targeting_help:
Hybrid: Tap once to lock on when a target is found. Double-tap when none is found to hold L.
Hold: L stays held only while your finger is on the button.
Switch: Tap L to keep it held. Tap again to release it.
input.touch_camera_x_help:
Adjusts touch camera horizontal sensitivity.

Applies to touch input only.
input.touch_camera_y_help:
Adjusts touch camera vertical sensitivity.

Applies to touch input only.
input.free_camera_help: Enables free camera control, letting you control the camera fully with the C-Stick.
input.camera_sensitivity_help: Applies to the control stick only.
input.invert_camera_help: Applies to the control stick only.
input.invert_fp_help:
Invert horizontal movement while aiming with items or first person camera.

Applies to the control stick only.
input.gyro_aim_help:
Enables gyro controls while in look mode, aiming a hawk, and aiming supported items.

Supported items include the Slingshot, Gale Boomerang, Hero's Bow, Clawshot(s), Ball and Chain, and Dominion Rod.
input.gyro_rollgoal_help: Enables gyro controls for Rollgoal in Hena's Cabin.
input.rollgoal_sensitivity_help: Controls how strongly gyro input tilts the Rollgoal table.
input.gyro_deadband_help: Ignores small gyro movement to reduce drift and jitter.
input.gyro_smoothing_help: Higher values smooth gyro input over time.
input.mouse_aim_help:
Enables mouse input while in look mode, aiming a hawk, and aiming supported items.

Supported items include the Slingshot, Gale Boomerang, Hero's Bow, Clawshot(s), Ball and Chain, and Dominion Rod.
input.mouse_camera_help: Enables mouse input for controlling the third-person camera.
input.invert_mouse_y_help: Invert vertical mouse control for both aiming and camera.
input.menu_pointer_help: Enables mouse and touch input for supported in-game menus.
input.invert_air_swim_x_help: Invert horizontal movement while flying or swimming.
input.invert_air_swim_y_help: Invert vertical movement while flying or swimming.
input.swap_direct_select_help: Swap the controls for using Direct Select on the item wheel, making Direct Select the default and holding L to scroll the wheel.
input.turbo_key_help: Hold Tab to increase game speed by up to 4x.

audio.master_volume_help: Adjusts the volume of all sounds in the game.
audio.main_music_volume_help: Adjusts the volume of all music in the game.
audio.enable_reverb_help: Enables the reverb effect in game audio.
audio.menu_sounds_help: Play sound effects when navigating the Dusklight menu.
audio.no_low_hp_sound_help: Disable the beeping sound when having low health.
audio.midnas_lament_help: Prevents enemy music while Midna's Lament is playing.

gameplay.mirror_mode_help: Mirrors the world horizontally, matching the Wii version of the game.
gameplay.minimal_hud_help:
Disables the elements of the main HUD of the game.
Useful for a more immersive experience.
gameplay.hud_scale_help: Scales the size of the gameplay HUD (hearts, buttons, mini-map, etc.). Does not affect dialog boxes or menus.
gameplay.restore_wii_glitches_help: Restores patched glitches from Wii USA 1.0, the first released version.
gameplay.rotating_link_doll_help: Enables rotating Link in the collection menu with the C-Stick.
gameplay.hide_owl_markers_help: Removes completed Owl Statue markers from the map and Minimap.
gameplay.instant_death_help: Any hit will instantly kill you.
gameplay.no_heart_drops_help: Hearts will never drop from enemies, pots, and various other places.
gameplay.bigger_wallets_help: Wallet sizes are like in the HD version. (500, 1000, 2000)
gameplay.disable_rupee_cutscenes_help: Rupees will not play cutscenes after you have collected them the first time.
gameplay.faster_transitions_help: Reduces how long the transitions take when changing maps.
gameplay.faster_climbing_help: Quicker climbing on ladders and vines like the HD version.
gameplay.faster_tears_help: Tears of Light dropped by Shadow Insects pop out faster like the HD version.
gameplay.autosave_help: Autosaves the game when going to a new area or opening a dungeon door.
gameplay.instant_saves_help: Skips the delay when writing to the Memory Card.
gameplay.instant_text_help: Makes text scroll immediately by holding B.
gameplay.hold_to_mash_help: Hold the indicated button to mash automatically.
gameplay.no_miss_climbing_help: Prevents Link from playing a struggle animation when grabbing ledges or climbing on vines.
gameplay.no_rupee_returns_help: Always collect Rupees even if your Wallet is too full.
gameplay.no_sword_recoil_help: Link will not recoil when his sword hits walls.
gameplay.no_2nd_fish_help: Skip needing to catch a second fish for Sera's cat.
gameplay.button_fishing_help: Allow fishing with the Fishing Rod using the button the item is assigned to.
gameplay.poe_count_map_help: Displays collected/total number of Poe Souls for a region on the map.
gameplay.suns_song_help: Allows Wolf Link to howl and change the time of day.
gameplay.quick_transform_help: Transform instantly by pressing R and Y simultaneously.
gameplay.aiming_reticle_help: Shows the aiming reticle for bow and slingshot.
gameplay.speedrun_mode_help: Enables Speedrun game mode option in the Dusklight launch menu.
gameplay.livesplit_help: Connect to LiveSplit server on localhost:16834. For this to work you must right click LiveSplit, and turn on Control -> Start TCP Server. To see IGT in LiveSplit you must change your comparison to Game Time.
gameplay.show_rta_help: Display the RTA timer. IGT is always visible.

cheats.infinite_oxygen_help: Keeps your underwater oxygen meter full.
cheats.no_item_timer_help: Item drops such as rupees and hearts will never disappear after they drop.
cheats.moon_jump_help: Hold R and A to rise into the air.
cheats.easy_quick_spin_help: Hold R to always do a Quick Spin when attacking with B.
cheats.super_clawshot_help: Extends Clawshot behavior beyond the normal game rules.
cheats.always_greatspin_help: Allows the Great Spin attack without requiring full health.
cheats.fast_iron_boots_help: Speeds up movement while heavy, including wearing the Iron Boots, holding the Ball and Chain, wearing Magic Armor without rupees, etc.
cheats.transform_anywhere_help: Allows transforming even if NPCs are looking.
cheats.fast_roll_help: Makes Link's roll animation and movement twice as fast.
cheats.fast_spinner_help: Speeds up Spinner movement while holding R.
cheats.magic_armor_help: Control the behavior of the Magic Armor.

interface.open_data_folder_help: Open the folder where Dusklight stores settings, saves, logs, texture replacements, and other app data.
interface.restart_main_menu_help: Restart Dusklight to the pre-launch menu to change settings, game modes, or mods.
interface.crash_reporting_help:
Dusklight can automatically send crash reports to the developers. Crash reports contain the following:
• Operating system version
• CPU architecture
• GPU model & driver version
• File paths (may include account username)
• Stack trace
interface.skip_main_menu_help:
When starting Dusklight, skip the main menu and boot straight into the game if a disc image is available.

Note: If any mods register game modes, this option will be ignored.
interface.shader_compilation_help: Show an overlay when shaders are being compiled for your hardware.
interface.check_updates_help:
Checks GitHub releases for a new Dusklight version on startup.

No personal information is transmitted or collected.
interface.discord_presence_help: Enable Dusklight to integrate with Discord Rich Presence. This allows Discord to show your status in-game.
interface.advanced_settings_help:
Show advanced settings and debugging tools with Shift+F1.

WARNING: Debugging tools can easily break your game. Do not use on a regular save!
interface.input_viewer_help: Display a controller input overlay while playing.
interface.gyro_input_viewer_help: Show gyro sensor values in the input viewer.
interface.menu_scaling_help: Changes how the Collection and File Select menus scale to your aspect ratio.
interface.skip_tv_settings_help: Skips the TV calibration screen shown when loading a save.
interface.recording_mode_help:
Disables the game HUD and all background music.

Useful for recording footage.

menu_language.help:
Language used by the Dusklight configuration menus.

Auto follows your system language when a translation is available.

tools.move_link_help: Enables the L+R+Y button combo to toggle freely repositioning Link.
tools.teleport_help:
R+D-pad Up stores Link's current position.
R+D-pad Down teleports Link back to it.

preset.title: Welcome to Dusklight
preset.intro: Choose a preset to get started. You can change any setting later from the Settings menu.
preset.classic_desc: Enhancements disabled to match the GameCube version. Good for speedrunning or simple nostalgia!
preset.dusklight_desc: Graphics & quality of life tweaks, including some from the Wii U version. Our recommended way to play!

reporting.title: Send Crash Reports
reporting.intro: Dusklight can automatically send crash reports to the developers. Crash reports contain the following:
reporting.change_anytime: This can be changed in the Settings menu at any time.
reporting.enable_desc: Send crash reports to Dusklight developers. Reports will include the information described above.
reporting.disable_desc: Do not send crash reports. This may make it more difficult to resolve issues you encounter.
